title: Retro GUI
description: Makes all GUI menus, experience bar, and other gui features have a purple and orange theme.
body:
This resource pack makes all gui menus have an orange and purple vertical gradient. It also has changes to the hotbar selector, gui menu, and gui text to be more readable and fit the theme in a more distinct way.

You can make your own GUI here: [https://mcglint.com/gui](https://mcglint.com/gui)
